articles.title: The Media Show - Russell T Davies, undercover investigations, and reporting on when the BBC gets it wrong - BBC Sounds
articles.summary: An extended interview with acclaimed screenwriter and producer Russell T Davies.
articles.body: This week, an extended interview with the screenwriter and producer Russell T Davies. He talks to Katie and Ros about his long career in television, from early days in children's TV, to bringing back Doctor Who, to his more recent successes like the critically acclaimed Tip Toe. He also gives his thoughts on the media landscape today, including the role of AI and the lack of commissioning opportunities. Also, former barrister and legal correspondent Clive Coleman, now a specialist in crisis PR and reputation management, and former BBC news exec Katy Searle discuss the BBC's defamation settlement with the founder of LGBTQ+ news site Pink News and his husband over a 2024 investigation. How should the BBC respond when it gets things wrong? And after Reform UK's Deputy Leader Richard Tice issued a statement criticising ITV for an upcoming investigation, we explore the editorial and legal implications of going undercover. Presenters: Katie Razzall and Ros Atkins Producers: Lisa Jenkinson and Tim Bano

articles.title: How to clean hardwood floors without warping or damaging them, according to experts
articles.summary: We found the best methods for cleaning hardwood floors that won’t end up ruining them in the process. Plus, cleaning experts recommended the best products for cleaning hardwood floors.
articles.body: High-quality hardwood floors can be time consuming and expensive to install, but they can also elevate the look of a home. With that in mind, keeping your hardwood floors clean is important, especially if you want them to last for years. But you should be mindful of how you're cleaning (and what you're using on) your hardwood floors. “Water and hardwood floors just don’t get along,” says Will Cotter, the owner of cleaning company HappyCleans. It’s better, instead, to focus more on using the right mop, appliances and cleaning solutions when taking care of hardwood. Everyone has their own take on the best way to clean hardwood floors, but I spoke with actual cleaning professionals, including Cotter, to find out the best way to clean wood floors without warping them. My colleagues and I also tested a few products. Want more from NBC Selected? Sign up for our newsletter, The Selection, and shop smarter. The best products for cleaning hardwood floors I spoke with cleaning experts for their guidance and product recommendations. All the cleaning products below are either direct recommendations from them, products NBC Selected editors have used to clean their floors or are highly rated with at least a four-star average rating from 500 reviews or more on Amazon. The best mops for hardwood floors The Bona hardwood floor spray mop, which comes with machine-washable microfiber cloths, comes recommended by both Cotter and Kadi Dulude, owner of the cleaning service Wizard of Home, who says it’s a favorite at her company. “The cloths are machine washable. The spray is convenient and sprays an even mist on the floor,” she says. “The result is a beautiful, gleaming floor.” The mop comes with a cleaning solution that attaches to the base of the mop. The plant-based solution also dries quickly after application and doesn’t leave streaks or visible residue, according to the brand. The brand sent me a sample of this floor cleaning kit to test and I love how fast it is to set up It comes with two batteries, an extra mop pad and the bottled solution locks into the compartment easily. Plus, all I had to do was press the button on the top to spray the solution from each side of the end of the mop. It sprays the perfect amount, the solution dries fast and it does a great job of cleaning up dust. It also collapses down if you want to store it in a cabinet. This spin mop has two circular microfiber, machine-washable pads (it comes with six total) that attach to the end and spring simultaneously to clean and buff hardwood floors. It also has a built-in sprayer to apply solution directly to dirt and debris, which you apply with the press of a button on the top of the handle. Aside from hardwood, it’s also suitable for tile, linoleum and more. NBC Selected social video producer Josh Rios has this popular spin mop and loves how much the built-in wring system takes the strain out of mopping. “This actually makes mopping more like a game and less like a chore which I sincerely enjoyed. It does take [up] a little bit of space but it’s so worth it,” he says. Each microfiber pad lasts for up to 3 months, the bucket holds more than 1.5 gallons of water and the handle is extendable up to 48 inches. It’s also available in a version that separates the clean and dirty water. While it isn’t a mop, this duster is so perfect for cleaning dust on hardwood floors — especially when it’s around baseboards or under furniture — that I thought it was worth highlighting. NBC Selected reporter Zoe Malin uses this to clean up her floors and home, which helps a lot as she’s a dog and cat owner. The handle extends to 3 feet and the end of the duster bends, making it easy to clean the top of ceiling fans and shelves. The kit comes with 12 attachment refills. The best cleaning solutions for hardwood floors This set includes both a wood-safe cleaning solution and a polish restorer, which adds extra sheen to hardwood floors. You can squeeze a small amount of the cleaning solution directly onto the floor or add it to the compartment of a spray mop and apply it that way. Afterward, simply allow the floors to dry and then add the polish restore solution to make them look shiny and refreshed. You can use Method’s plant-based, almond-scented solution to clean residue from dirty hardwood floors, though you can also apply it to laminate floors, too, according to the brand. Since there’s no rinse required, you can apply the solution with a clean microfiber pad and allow it to dry before applying your favorite wood floor polish. The best vacuums for hardwood floors I’ve written a lot about vacuums, including many of Dyson’s popular cordless options, including the V11. This model has a runtime of one hour, weighs less than 7 pounds and comes with multiple attachments. Former NBC Selected reporter Harry Rabinowitz has owned the V10, a similar model, for more than five years and says that although it’s on the expensive side, it’s worth it. “It’s lightweight, portable, adjustable and has enough battery to clean my entire home. Plus it’s pretty easy to store,” he says. Also, “Dyson makes it pretty easy to buy replacement parts if needed (the hair screw tool looks like a tempting upgrade).” I wouldn’t be able to tell you how many times I’ve recommended this ultra-popular vacuum to everyone I know (including my mom). One of the MVPs of upright vacuums, the Shark Navigator Lift-Away works on carpet and hardwood floors and comes with attachments (upholstery, dusting brush and crevice) for cleaning furniture. The top of the vacuum also detaches so you can clean elevated areas. How to clean hardwood floors, according to experts There are several different methods to clean hardwood floors. According to professional home cleaners, this is the best way to clean hardwoods without damaging them: Start by sweeping your hardwood floors thoroughly with a broom and dustpan, making sure to remove all visible debris, dust and crumbs. Use a duster or dusting mop to clean up any residual dust around corners, on baseboards and under furniture. After sweeping and dusting, use a vacuum to remove any residual debris from the floor. Use a spray mop to clean the floors, making sure to add the solution to the compartment and spray it onto the floor directly. Don’t pour water onto the floor. You can also apply a hardwood floor cleaner directly onto the floor and then mop.Alternatively, you can use a spin mop with a few tablespoons of cleaning solution diluted with water. Be sure to spin it dry extremely thoroughly. Your floors shouldn’t have puddles of water. Allow the cleaning solution to dry completely on its own. Apply a hardwood floor polish to the floors, such as the Weiman Hardwood Floor Polish Restorer, according to the directions. We also take steps to ensure all expert advice and recommendations are made independently and without undisclosed financial conflicts of interest. Will Cotter is founder of home cleaning services companies FreshSpace Cleaning and Deluxe Maid. Kadi Dulude is the founder of home cleaning services company Wizards of Home, which has more than 100 trained cleaning professionals. Why trust NBC Selected? I’m a commerce editor at NBC Selected, where I regularly write roundups, reviews and explainers about cleaning, laundry, cooking and home care. I’ve written guides on how to clean a mattress, how to get rid of mold and the best way to clean grout in your bathroom. articles.title: Pescador é resgatado após ser arrastado pela maré em Salinópolis | G1
articles.standfirst: Homem de 45 anos foi levado pela força da maré na praia do Farol Velho. Resgate foi feito pelos bombeiros com moto aquática e equipe de salvamento.
articles.summary: Homem de 45 anos foi levado pela força da maré na praia do Farol Velho. Resgate foi feito pelos bombeiros com moto aquática e equipe de salvamento.
articles.body:
Um pescador de 45 anos foi resgatado pelo Corpo de Bombeiros em Salinópolis , no litoral do Pará, após ter sido arrastado pela força do mar. O resgate foi na noite de terça-feira (13) e registrado em vídeo.

Segundo os bombeiros, Francisco Junior Lima havia sido levado pela força da maré na praia do Farol Velho. De acordo com os militares, ele pescava com uma rede de arrasto quando o acidente aconteceu.

Para localizar o homem, os bombeiros realizaram buscas no mar com o auxílio de uma moto aquática e de profissionais especializados em salvamento aquático. Não foram divulgadas informações sobre o estado de saúde do pescador resgatado.

articles.title: Cheia do rio Uruguai deixa mais de 400 pessoas fora de casa no RS | G1
articles.standfirst: Elevação do nível das águas retira moradores de imóveis em Uruguaiana, Itaqui e São Borja, todas na Fronteira Oeste.
articles.summary: Elevação do nível das águas já deixa mais de 400 pessoas fora de casa em Uruguaiana, Itaqui e São Borja.
articles.body:
A bacia do rio Uruguai está acima da cota de inundação em diversos pontos do Rio Grande do Sul. A elevação do nível das águas já deixa mais de 400 pessoas fora de casa em Uruguaiana , Itaqui e São Borja . A tendência é de baixa em São Borja, mas de consequente alta nas outras duas cidades.

Em Uruguaiana, são 194 pessoas fora de casa . O nível do rio está em 9,93 metros no município no início da tarde desta quarta-feira (14), acima da cota de inundação de 8,5m. São 162 desalojadas, na casa de parentes, vizinhos ou amigos, e 32 em abrigos.

Em Itaqui, são 192 pessoas fora de casa. Destas, 182 estão desalojadas e 10 permanecem em abrigos.

Em São Borja, 22 deixaram suas casas. O nível do Uruguai no município da Fronteira Oeste é de 10,48m , com tendência de baixa. Para as águas descerem, contudo, a bacia passa por Itaqui e Uruguaiana, até cruzar a fronteira entre Argentina e Uruguai para desaguar no Mar del Plata.

Muitas pessoas buscam voltar para suas residências não apenas por conforto, mas por ocorrências de furtos a casas vazias de pessoas que precisam se abrigar.

“A gente quer ficar perto da casa da gente porque existem muitos furtos. De onde que tiro forças para continuar? De Deus”, lamenta a aposentada Eva Maria Farias, moradora de Uruguaiana.

A previsão do tempo ajuda. A Fronteira Oeste deve ter tempo seco nesta quarta e na quinta, sexta-feira e sábado, com sol entre nuvens e sem chuva.

articles.title: Paulo Dantas se afasta do governo de Alagoas pela campanha de Lula | G1
articles.standfirst: Licença vai até 30 de outubro. Presidente da Assembleia Legislativa, Marcelo Victor assume o comando do estado nesta quarta-feira (14).
articles.summary: Paulo Dantas se afasta do governo de Alagoas para coordenar a campanha de Lula, deixando o cargo sob comando de Marcelo Victor até o fim de outubro.
articles.body:
Paulo Dantas (MDB) e Lula (PT). — Foto: Ricardo Stuckert / PR

O governador de Alagoas, Paulo Dantas ( MDB ), vai se afastar do cargo nesta quarta-feira (14) para coordenar a campanha de reeleição do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva ( PT ) no estado.

A licença vai até 30 de outubro, cinco dias após o segundo turno das eleições presidenciais.

Durante o afastamento, o presidente da Assembleia Legislativa de Alagoas (ALE), deputado Marcelo Victor (MDB) , assumirá temporariamente o Governo do Estado. A transmissão do cargo está marcada para as 18h desta quarta-feira (14).

A informação foi divulgada pela Secretaria de Estado da Comunicação (Secom).

Marcelo Victor assume o Executivo porque o cargo de vice-governador está vago desde a renúncia de Ronaldo Lessa ( PDT ), na última sexta-feira (9).

A disputa será entre Lula (PT), que tenta a reeleição, e Flávio Bolsonaro ( PL ).

No primeiro turno, realizado no dia 4 de outubro, Flávio recebeu 47,03% dos votos válidos, enquanto Lula obteve 45,16%.

Nas eleições estaduais, Paulo Dantas apoiou a candidatura de Renan Filho (MDB) ao governo de Alagoas.

Apesar do apoio do atual governador, Renan Filho foi derrotado por JHC ( PSDB ), eleito no primeiro turno.

Após a derrota de seu grupo político na disputa estadual, Paulo Dantas decidiu intensificar a participação na campanha presidencial.

O governador também participa da articulação de uma frente de apoio a Lula em Alagoas, ao lado de Renan Filho e do presidente estadual do PT, deputado Ronaldo Medeiros.

articles.title: Quem é Patrick Assisi, da máfia italiana e marido de influencer presa | G1
articles.standfirst: Patrick Assisi é apontado como integrante da máfia italiana 'Ndrangheta. Ele foi preso ao lado do pai, Nicola Assisi, em 2019, e deixou a esposa e influenciadora Paula Simões como herdeira operacional do esquema de tráfico internacional de drogas com envio de cocaína para a Europa.
articles.summary: Patrick Assisi, da máfia 'Ndrangheta, coordenava o tráfico de cocaína com a esposa Paula Simões, apontada pela PF como sua herdeira operacional no crime.
articles.body:
Casado com a influenciadora Paula Simões, Patrick Assisi é apontado pela Polícia Federal como integrante da máfia italiana N'Drangheta e teria participado de um esquema de tráfico internacional de drogas com envio de cocaína para a Europa a partir de portos brasileiros. Segundo as investigações, após a prisão de Patrick, Paula Simões assumiu a coordenação da organização criminosa no Brasil.

De acordo com as investigações, Patrick foi preso em julho de 2019 ao lado do pai, Nicola Assisi, na Operação Barão Invisível, coordenada pela Polícia Federal do Paraná.

Na época, as investigações apontavam que a organização era a responsável por controlar aproximadamente de 40% dos envios globais de cocaína à Europa, principal mercado consumidor.

Os dois eram alvos de mandados de prisão do Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF), a pedido da Representação da Polícia Federal junto à Interpol, em cooperação com a polícia italiana. Pai e filho estavam em uma cobertura de luxo na orla da Aviação, em Praia Grande, no litoral de São Paulo.

Nicola Assisi e Patrick Assisi foram presos pela Polícia Federal em Praia Grande, SP — Foto: Adriana Cutino/TV Tribuna

Os policiais do Grupo de Pronta Intervenção (GPI) cercaram a região. No apartamento, havia três armas, quase cinco quilos de cocaína e grande quantidade em dinheiro em moeda nacional e estrangeira. No local, além dos ilícitos, havia um compartimento secreto no fundo falso de uma parede, que poderia também ser utilizado como rota de fuga.

Segundo a polícia italiana, pai e filho trabalhavam em conjunto com uma das maiores facções criminosas brasileiras, que atua dentro e fora dos presídios do país. Eles são suspeitos de enviar cocaína à Europa pelos portos de Santos e de Paranaguá (PR).

Ainda de acordo com a polícia italiana, Nicola estava prestes a se aposentar do crime para aproveitar a vida em algum lugar no Brasil, onde ambos eram procurados desde 2014. A Interpol também estava atrás deles desde a ocasião. A suspeita é que pai e filho tenham viajado utilizando documentos falsos pela América Latina até serem presos em Praia Grande.

Patrick Assisi foi condenado no Brasil a mais de 14 anos de reclusão , em sentença que manteve a prisão preventiva. Ele foi transferido do presídio em Rondônia para o Sistema Penitenciário Federal, em Brasília.

Em 2022, a defesa dele solicitou a transferência dele para um presídio em São Paulo. O pedido foi negado por ele apresentar risco a ordem e a segurança pública, "uma vez que mesmo recluso no SPF continuaria a exercer um papel de liderança na organização criminosa internacional, sendo considerado um preso de altíssima periculosidade, existindo ainda indícios de ligação com líderes da facção criminosa "PCC".

Patrick Assisi e a esposa Paula Simões — Foto: Divulgação e Reprodução/Instagram

Após as prisões em 2019, para a Polícia Federal, a organização continuou operando. A influenciadora e esposa de Patrick Assisi, a brasileira Paula Simões assumiu a coordenação das atividades ligadas ao tráfico de cocaína como uma espécie de "herdeira operacional" do grupo.

Segundo a investigação, Paula teria contado com a ajuda do advogado Patrick Cardoso , que defendia os mafiosos presos e atuaria como intermediário entre eles. Ele se aproveitava do contato reservado com os clientes para transmitir orientações sobre os negócios criminosos.

Patrick Cardoso e Paula Simões, suspeitos de envolvimento com máfia — Foto: Reprodução/TV Globo

Os investigadores afirmam que, mesmo preso, Patrick Assisi continuou exercendo influência sobre os negócios da organização. A polícia encontrou fotografias de bilhetes produzidos dentro da Superintendência da PF em São Paulo.

Neles, os mafiosos davam ordens sobre os negócios da organização, incluindo a cobrança de dívidas. Em uma das cartas, Patrick Assisi orientava Paula a enviar um comparsa conhecido como "BXX" para recuperar dinheiro e bens que pudessem ser vendidos.

As investigações apontam que o grupo utilizava a estrutura logística do Porto de Paranaguá , no Paraná, para enviar cocaína à Europa escondida em contêineres, além de utilizar mecanismos financeiros clandestinos para movimentar recursos do tráfico internacional.

Paula Simões foi apontada pela PF como 'herdeira operacional' de esquema ligado à máfia italiana ‘Ndrangueta’ — Foto: Redes sociais

No Instagram, Paula se apresenta como criadora de conteúdo digital e influenciadora. O perfil reúne publicações sobre assuntos variados, como maquiagem, cuidados estéticos, música e vídeos de dança.

"Se as pessoas soubessem que tenho coragem de botar fogo nelas não arriscavam tanto...", escreveu a influenciadora. Não há indicação de que a publicação tenha relação com os crimes investigados ou de que a frase tenha sido dirigida a alguma pessoa específica.

A decisão judicial também aponta indícios de que Paula tenha administrado aproximadamente 2,2 toneladas de cocaína que permaneceram sob controle do grupo após a prisão dos familiares. Segundo a PF, mesmo depois da apreensão desse estoque, ela teria continuado a adquirir outros carregamentos.

Segundo os investigadores, Paula utilizava o codinome 'Chanel' no SkyECC, aplicativo de mensagens criptografadas. A investigação analisou conversas realizadas entre janeiro de 2020 e fevereiro de 2021.

Paula Simões é suspeita de assumir o comando de esquema de tráfico internacional de drogas — Foto: Reprodução/Fantástico

A PF também aponta que a ascensão de Paula Simões ao comando das operações provocou tensões dentro da própria organização . Conforme a investigação, integrantes da 'Ndrangheta passaram a ameaçá-la após descobrirem um suposto relacionamento extraconjugal entre ela e o advogado.

Segundo a corporação, integrantes da máfia chegaram a afirmar que a "cabeça" da influenciadora valia cerca de 250 mil euros , o equivalente a aproximadamente R$ 1,4 milhão, por ela estar usufruindo de viagens e luxo financiados pelo narcotráfico ao lado do advogado entre 2019 e 2023.

A cúpula da organização também teria pressionado Paula Simões a quitar dívidas relacionadas a carregamentos de cocaína e a se afastar de Patrick Cardoso.

Paula e Patrick Cardoso foram presos na Operação Eredità, com mandados sendo cumpridos em Palhoça (SC), São Paulo (SP), São Caetano do Sul (SP), Santos (SP) e Americana (SP). A Justiça também determinou o bloqueio de bens e valores e o sequestro de imóveis dos investigados.

A investigação reuniu elementos de apurações anteriores, entre elas as operações Retis e Spiderweb. A ação foi conduzida por uma Equipe Conjunta de Investigação formada por autoridades do Brasil e da Itália entre 2020 e 2025. Do lado brasileiro, participaram a Polícia Federal e o Ministério Público Federal. Na Itália, integraram o trabalho o Departamento Anticrime de Turim do ROS Carabinieri e o Ministério Público de Turim.

A defesa de Patrick Cardoso afirmou que o advogado sempre atuou dentro dos limites da advocacia ao longo de 25 anos de carreira e que já apresentou um pedido de revogação da prisão preventiva.

O advogado de Paula Simões afirmou que ela nega todas as acusações e que nenhuma droga foi apreendida com ela. Segundo a defesa, a suspeita de que as atividades criminosas teriam continuado após a prisão dos Assisi são inferências da autoridade policial, não fatos comprovados.

articles.title: Após caos no trânsito, homem é preso com peças de semáforo furtado | G1
articles.standfirst: Equipamento foi levado de cruzamento da capital na terça-feira (13). Ferro-velho clandestino foi fechado pela Guarda Civil Metropolitana.
articles.summary: Equipamento foi levado de cruzamento da capital na terça-feira (13). Ferro-velho clandestino foi fechado pela Guarda Civil Metropolitana.
articles.body:
Controlador de semáforo encontrado em ferro-velho — Foto: Reprodução

Um homem de 42 anos foi preso por receptação após peças de um semáforo furtado serem encontradas em um ferro-velho clandestino, em Campo Grande. O estabelecimento foi fechado pela Guarda Civil Metropolitana (GCM) na madrugada desta quarta-feira (14).

As peças pertenciam a um controlador de semáforo furtado na terça-feira (13), no cruzamento das ruas Brigadeiro Thiago e José Paes de Faria. Uma delas ainda tinha a identificação do local onde o equipamento estava instalado, o que permitiu confirmar a origem do material.

A descoberta ocorre em meio a furtos de equipamentos de sinalização que têm provocado transtornos no trânsito da capital. Na terça-feira, o MS1, da TV Morena, mostrou a situação de outro cruzamento que ficou sem semáforo após um furto.

Segundo a GCM, equipes já monitoravam suspeitos de furtar controladores de semáforos na cidade. Por volta das 3h desta quarta-feira, os guardas fiscalizaram um ferro-velho na Travessa Brisa e encontraram os componentes.

A Agência Municipal de Transporte e Trânsito (Agetran) confirmou que as peças pertenciam ao equipamento furtado no dia anterior.

De acordo com o boletim de ocorrência, a responsável pelo ferro-velho afirmou que o material havia sido comprado durante o dia e indicou o homem que teria feito a pesagem e a compra.

Os dois foram levados à Delegacia de Pronto Atendimento Comunitário (Depac/Cepol). O homem foi preso em flagrante por receptação, enquanto a mulher prestou depoimento e foi liberada.

Segundo a Secretaria Especial de Segurança e Defesa Social (Sesdes), a Guarda registrou 140 ações de fiscalização de ferros-velhos entre janeiro e outubro deste ano, contra 116 durante todo o ano de 2025.

As ações resultaram em 18 autuações, 34 notificações ambientais e sete suspeitos encaminhados à polícia, além de uma prisão.

No mesmo período, a Guarda registrou 93 ocorrências para averiguar ou constatar furtos de fios em Campo Grande.

Denúncias de furtos e venda irregular de metais podem ser feitas pelo telefone 153.

articles.title: Alerta de tempestade em Piracicaba: Granizo e ventos de 100 km/h | G1
articles.standfirst: Defesa Civil de São Paulo e Inmet emitiram avisos de perigo para temporal entre esta quarta e quinta-feira (15). Veja como se proteger.
articles.summary: Defesa Civil emite alerta de tempestade em Piracicaba com risco de granizo, alagamentos e ventos de 100 km/h entre esta quarta e quinta-feira.
articles.body:
A Defesa Civil de São Paulo emitiu alerta roxo de perigo para tempestades na região de Piracicaba (SP) nesta quarta-feira (14). Um cavado meteorológico, associado à aproximação de uma frente fria pelo oceano, deve manter o tempo instável até quinta-feira (15).

"A previsão indica pancadas de chuva em todas as regiões paulistas, acompanhadas de raios e rajadas de vento, com possibilidade de temporais e queda pontual de granizo. Após dias consecutivos de chuva, o solo estará mais saturado, aumentando o potencial para alagamentos, enxurradas e elevação dos níveis de rios e córregos, principalmente nas áreas mais vulneráveis", descreveu.

Segundo o alerta, são esperadas chuvas generalizadas, de intensidade moderada a forte.

Região de Piracicaba tem alerta para temporais nesta quarta-feira — Foto: Claudia Assencio/g1

"Na quinta-feira (15), as pancadas de chuva persistem em todo o território estadual, com possibilidade de volumes expressivos principalmente nas regiões que fazem divisa com Minas Gerais", acrescentou.

Defesa Civil emitiu alertas para temporal — Foto: Reprodução/g1

A Defesa Civil de São Paulo recomenda os seguintes cuidados:

Não atravesse ruas alagadas, enxurradas ou áreas com correnteza, a pé ou de veículo.

Evite permanecer em áreas baixas próximas a rios e córregos durante chuvas fortes.

Ao perceber rachaduras no solo ou nas paredes, inclinação de árvores e postes ou estalos em encostas, deixe o local e procure abrigo seguro.

Durante tempestades com raios e ventos fortes, afaste-se de áreas abertas, árvores, postes e estruturas metálicas.

Ao dirigir sob chuva intensa, reduza a velocidade, aumente a distância entre os veículos e nunca tente atravessar trechos alagados.

A Defesa Civil reforça a importância de manter o celular habilitado para receber alertas de emergência. Para receber avisos por SMS, basta enviar o CEP da localidade desejada para o número 40199.

Em situações de emergência, os telefones são 199, da Defesa Civil, e 193, do Corpo de Bombeiros.

Piracicaba (SP) registrou o dia mais quente de 2026 na tarde da última sexta-feira (9) , ao atingir os 35,2ºC. Segundo dados do Posto Meteorológico da Escola Superior de Agricultura "Luiz de Queiroz Esalq/USP, a nova marca supera o antigo recorde do ano no município, verificado em 9 de janeiro.

Com as altas temperaturas, o índice de relativa umidade do ar (URA) ficou em 39% abaixo do ideal para a saúde humana nesta sexta. Nível recomendado é de 60%.

O índice de umidade do ar melhorou com as chuvas entre domingo (11) e terça-feira (13), variando entre 60% e 74%.

Depois de bater recorde de menor temperatura do ano, Piracicaba tem alerta para onda de calor — Foto: Claudia Assencio/g1

A primavera começou com dias quentes e predominância de sol na região de Piracicaba (SP) em setembro, com máximas acima dos 34ºC.

As temperaturas máximas elevadas são comuns nesse período , inclusive normalmente superam as marcas registradas no verão, de acordo com o professor e pesquisador Fábio Marin, do Departamento de Engenharia de Biossistemas (LEB) da Escola Superior de Agricultura Luiz de Queiroz (Esalq), o campus da Universidade de São Paulo (USP).

Confira na previsão do Inmet como ficam as temperaturas nos próximos dias:

Quarta-feira (14) : mínima de 18°C e máxima de 33°C

Quinta (15): mínima de 19°C e máxima de 27°C

Sexta (16): mínima de 17°C e máxima de 26ºC

Sábado (17): mínima de 17°C e máxima de 25°C

Início da primavera tem temperaturas acima dos 35ºC em cidades da região de Piracicaba — Foto: Claudia Assencio/g1

Como o El Niño interfere no campo e na cidade?

O professor e pesquisador da USP afirma que as chuvas desta época favorecem a agricultura, mas impactam negativamente as cidades, os centros urbanos, com as enchentes.

"A expectativa é chuva. Não é de seca e fogo. A Defesa Civil tem que ficar preparada para deslizamento e alagamento", alertou.

Pôr do sol sobre a lavoura — Foto: Divulgação/Francisco Salesio Schmitt.

O professor Fabio Marin aponta perspectivas favoráveis para a agricultura. O comparativo histórico demonstra que o comportamento atual de chuvas volumosas em setembro assemelha-se ao padrão observado durante o forte El Niño de 2015, reforçando a tendência de precipitações acima da média no Sudeste.

Já o Norte e o Nordeste enfrentam realidades distintas regidas pela escassez hídrica e pela neutralidade das temperaturas no Oceano Atlântico.

"Essa é uma tendência boa para a agricultura, do Triângulo Mineiro pra baixo. Ao norte do Brasil, a preocupação é o contrário. Lá, a preocupação é mais a seca, especialmente no extremo norte, Pará, Amazonas, Roraima, Amapá e, inclusive, o Nordeste. Mas, o Nordeste é regulado pela temperatura do Oceano Atlântico. Não é só a temperatura do Pacífico que controla o Nordeste. O Atlântico está neutro, nem desfavorecendo, nem favorecendo", analisou o especialista.

Para o Sudeste, a perspectiva é boa para a agricultura, com exceção da cana-de-açúcar, que precisa ser colhida ainda no campo.

No setor sucroenergético, a colheita da safra atual estende-se até dezembro devido a atrasos operacionais decorrentes da umidade, provocando uma queda no teor de açúcar dos canaviais (ATR).

"Essa safra deve chegar até dezembro, com pouquinho de atraso. Também cai um pouquinho o teor de açúcar dos canaviais, a gente chama do ATR, fica mais baixo. A produtividade melhora, mas a concentração de açúcar cai e deve sobrar cana pro ano que vem. Chamamos isso de cana bisada. Mas, por outro lado, as canas que estão no campo, que já foram colhidas, são muito favorecidas e devem produzir bem em 2027", disse.

"Começamos a ter um olhar otimista aqui para as culturas. Pastagens também favorecidas, a semeadura de grãos [aqui] na região também favorecidas por conta da chuva", acresecentou.

articles.title: Eleitores votam para prefeito e vice em Martinópolis e Narandiba  | G1
articles.standfirst: As eleições suplementares ocorrem devido à cassação dos políticos eleitos em 2024. A votação municipal acontecerá simultaneamente ao 2º turno da eleição para presidente da República.
articles.summary: Os eleitores de Miartnópolis e Narandiba, no interior de SP, votam para prefeito e vice-prefeito em 25 de outubro. Neste dia, também ocorre o 2º turno das eleições presidenciais.
articles.body:
Os eleitores de Martinópolis (SP) e Narandiba (SP) votam para prefeito e vice-prefeito em 25 de outubro . As eleições suplementares ocorrem devido à cassação dos políticos eleitos em 2024. A votação municipal acontecerá simultaneamente ao 2º turno da eleição para presidente da República.

A ordem de votação na urna eletrônica em Martinópolis e Narandiba será: primeiro o voto para presidente da República e, na sequência, o voto para prefeito. A tela exibirá as informações e a barra de progresso nessa ordem.

Conforme o TRE, a 71ª Zona Eleitoral de Martinópolis será responsável pelas eleições do próprio município, que serão realizadas em 13 locais de votação e 61 seções eleitorais. O eleitorado local é de 18.082 pessoas.

Em Narandiba, os três locais de votação e 13 seções eleitorais são de responsabilidade da 261ª Zona Eleitoral de Pirapozinho. Estão aptos a votar no pleito 4.462 eleitores.

Conforme o Tribunal Regional Eleitoral de São Paulo (TRE-SP), em Martinópolis, a nova votação ocorre após a cassação dos mandatos do prefeito Valdeci Soares dos Santos Filho (Republicanos) e do vice Marcos Rogério Matarazo (Podemos) , eleitos em 2024.

De acordo com o TRE-SP, a perda dos mandatos ocorreu em razão de abuso de poder político e econômico , quando a administração municipal apresentou um projeto de lei de reestruturação de cargos sem observar os requisitos legais.

Prefeito de Martinópolis, Valdeci Soares dos Santos Filho, o “Soró”, e o vice-prefeito Marcos Rogério Matarazo — Foto: Reprodução/Redes Sociais

Além disso, o prefeito e o vice eleitos em 2024 também teriam disponibilizado transporte gratuito para eleitores na semana anterior às eleições, sem justificativa válida.

Diante disso, em decisão unânime, o TRE-SP reverteu a sentença da 71ª Zona Eleitoral de Martinópolis e cassou os mandatos dos réus.

O tribunal aplicou ainda ao prefeito a sanção de inelegibilidade, afastada quanto ao vice-prefeito. Os réus apresentaram recurso especial, que não foi admitido pelo TRE-SP. O caso seguia em análise no Tribunal Superior Eleitoral (TSE).

Os candidatos a prefeito e vice-prefeito em Martinópolis são:

Gabriel Valões Santos (MDB) e vice Thais Medeiros Souza (Podemos)

Humberto Emmanuel Schmidt Oliveira (União Brasil) e vice Fernanda Xavier Passos Crepaldi (União Brasil);

Marcos Xavier de Almeida Passos Junior (PSDB) e vice Maurina de Souza Cordeiro (PSD).

Segundo o TRE-SP, em Narandiba, a nova eleição ocorre após a cassação dos mandatos do prefeito Danillo Carvalho dos Santos (Republicanos) e da vice-prefeita Joana Rita Ribas Branco (MDB) por abuso de poder econômico .

A ação foi proposta pela coligação “Narandiba Para Todos” (PDT, PRD e PSB) e por Luiz Carlos Porto Martins (PSB), sob a alegação de captação ilícita de votos por meio de pagamentos via Pix e de doações de materiais de construção .

Prefeito de Narandiba, Danilo divulgou nas redes socias um nota oficial sobre o caso — Foto: Reprodução

Em votação unânime, a Justiça Eleitoral manteve a decisão do juízo da 261ª Zona Eleitoral de Pirapozinho, que cassou o mandato dos eleitos e condenou os réus ao pagamento de multa.

O recurso especial interposto por Danilo Carvalho dos Santos e Joana Rita Ribas Branco não foi admitido pelo TRE-SP, e o agravo em recurso especial aguardava julgamento pelo TSE.

Os candidatos a prefeito e vice-prefeito em Narandiba são:

Cláudio José Damacena (União Brasil) e vice Elder Magro (PSD);

Pedro de Barros (PRD) e vice Luiz Carlos Porto Martins (PSB).

articles.title: Ministério da Educação da Albânia é incendiado em protesto estudantil | G1
articles.standfirst: Assim como na França e na Índia, estudantes foram às ruas na capital albanesa para pedir melhores condições de educação e emprego. Vários edifícios foram vandalizados e houve confronto com a polícia.
articles.summary: Assim como na França e na Índia, estudantes foram às ruas na capital albanesa. Vários edifícios foram vandalizados e houve confronto com a polícia.
articles.body:
Estudantes da Albânia saíram às ruas para protestar por melhores condições de educação e emprego, na capital albanesa, Tirana, nesta quarta-feira (14).

No segundo dia de protestos no país - seguindo o exemplo da França e da Índia, que também estão em meio a manifestações estudantis -, os jovens vandalizaram prédios e entraram em confronto com os policiais, que jogaram bombas de gás lacrimogêneo para conter a multidão.

O edifício onde fica o Ministério da Educação albanês foi incendiado , segundo relato de testemunhas à agência de notícias Reuters, que noticiou a detenção de vários manifestantes.

Manifestante segura uma bandeira nacional da Albânia enquanto estudantes albaneses realizam um protesto antigovernamental em Tirana — Foto: REUTERS/Florion Goga

A vice-primeira-ministra da Albânia , Albana Koçiu, lamentou a violência dos protestos na rede social Facebook:

"A violência não foi, não é e nunca será uma solução. Atirar pedras, atacar instituições e a polícia, bem como destruir bens públicos sem sentido, não são formas de expressão da juventude".

À Reuters, os organizadores disseram que o protesto era contra as condições nas universidades, os custos do ensino superior, o apoio financeiro e as perspectivas de emprego após a formatura.

"O que a Albânia precisa é de uma revolução, uma mudança, uma derrubada completa do sistema, porque não pode continuar assim", disse a manifestante Luljeta Kola, acrescentando que existe uma profunda injustiça social e um abismo entre ricos e pobres no país.

articles.summary: Vassoura-de-bruxa no Amapá motiva decreto de emergência federal em 15 cidades; prefeituras podem solicitar recursos para o combate à praga.
articles.body:
Amapá tem 15 municípios em emergência federal devido à vassoura-de-bruxa. — Foto: Thiago Nunes/Rede Amazônica

A Defesa Civil Nacional reconheceu nesta terça-feira (13) a situação de emergência em 15 municípios do Amapá atingidos pela praga vassoura-de-bruxa.

A portaria oficial foi publicada no Diário Oficial da União (Dou).

articles.title: 'Rouanet Games': governo anuncia R$ 200 milhões para desenvolver games no Brasil | G1
articles.standfirst: Pacote prevê crédito mais barato para empresas do setor e criação do ‘Rouanet Games’, que permitirá captar patrocínios por meio da Lei Rouanet.
articles.summary: Pacote prevê crédito mais barato para empresas do setor e criação do ‘Rouanet Games’, que permitirá captar patrocínios por meio da Lei Rouanet.
articles.body:
Já no Centro de Convenções Vasco Vasques, começa o Tecnogame 2026, festival que reúne games, tecnologia, cultura geek, cosplay, e-sports, música e o aguardado show da banda japonesa Flow — Foto: Foto: Divulgação

O governo federal anunciou nesta quarta-feira (14) um pacote de medidas para incentivar a produção de videogames no Brasil, com R$ 200 milhões destinados ao financiamento do desenvolvimento de jogos e de soluções digitais inovadoras.

Os recursos serão disponibilizados por meio da Financiadora de Estudos e Projetos (Finep), agência pública que apoia projetos de pesquisa e inovação.

O anúncio ocorre durante a disputa do segundo turno da eleição presidencial entre o presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva e o senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). Durante o governo de seu pai, Jair Bolsonaro, houve redução do Imposto de Importação sobre videogames.

Uma das medidas prevê diminuir o valor mínimo dos empréstimos destinados ao setor por meio do Fundo Setorial do Audiovisual (FSA).

A proposta da Agência Nacional do Cinema (Ancine), que será apresentada ao comitê gestor do fundo, é reduzir o piso de R$ 500 mil para R$ 150 mil. Com isso, empresas que precisam de quantias menores poderão ter acesso ao financiamento.

O governo também propõe reduzir os juros cobrados nesses empréstimos. A taxa passaria de Taxa Referencial (TR) mais 2% ao ano para TR mais 0,5% ao ano. A TR é um indicador usado como referência em operações financeiras. Basicamente, a mudança busca tornar o crédito mais barato para as empresas.

Para 2026, o FSA prevê R$ 460 milhões em crédito para a indústria audiovisual, incluindo o setor de videogames.

O decreto também reconhece que as empresas de games podem acessar mecanismos federais de incentivo à tecnologia, à pesquisa, ao desenvolvimento, à inovação e à cultura.

Caberá à Ancine regulamentar o acesso do setor aos recursos da Lei do Audiovisual e propor critérios para o financiamento de projetos com dinheiro do FSA.

articles.title: Acidente entre van e carreta deixa duas pessoas mortas em Diamantina | G1
articles.standfirst: Segundo o Corpo de Bombeiros, van transportava pacientes do município de Capelinha (MG).
articles.summary: Segundo o Corpo de Bombeiros, van transportava pacientes do município de Capelinha (MG).
articles.body:
Duas pessoas morreram em um acidente envolvendo uma van e uma carreta na MGC-367, em Diamantina, na Região do Jequitinhonha, na manhã desta quarta-feira (14).

Segundo o Corpo de Bombeiros, a van levava pacientes de Capelinha, na mesma região, para tratamento de saúde em Diamantina. O veículo bateu de frente com a carreta, que transitava no sentido contrário, na altura do km 523.

Uma das vítimas morreu na hora. A outra chegou a ser socorrida, mas morreu em uma ambulância do Serviço de Atendimento Móvel de Urgência (Samu) a caminho do hospital.

Outras oito pessoas que estavam na van precisaram de atendimento médico. O motorista da carreta não ficou ferido.

O g1 entrou em contato com a Prefeitura de Capelinha, mas não obteve retorno até a última atualização desta reportagem.

articles.title: Vehicle thefts at highest level in decade in Devon and Cornwall
articles.summary: Police say organised crime groups are responsible for a significant proportion of vehicle thefts.
articles.body:
Vehicle thefts in Devon and Cornwall have risen to their highest level in at least a decade, with police linking the increase to organised criminal gangs and increasingly sophisticated theft techniques.

Devon and Cornwall Police recorded 1,550 vehicle theft offences in 2025-26, up 60.8% from 964 in 2015-16 and up 11.4% from 1,392 in 2024-25, Home Office data shows.

Police said organised crime groups were responsible for a significant proportion of vehicle thefts, with offenders increasingly using technology such as electronic key cloning to steal vehicles.

Despite a recent drop, vehicle thefts are up almost 50% in England and Wales compared with a decade ago, according to the figures.

Vehicle thefts in Devon and Cornwall remained relatively stable between 2015-16 and 2020-21, when there were 964 and 955 offences respectively, before climbing sharply to 1,491 offences in 2022-23. Although offences fell slightly to 1,392 in 2024-25, they rose again to 1,550 in 2025-26.

Det Ch Supt Ben Deer from the force, said: "The increase in vehicle theft offences is being driven by a range of factors, many of which are being seen across the UK."

Organised crime groups are thought to be responsible for a significant proportion of thefts, targeting vehicles for resale, dismantling them for parts or moving them through wider criminal networks.

Theft methods have also become increasingly sophisticated, with offenders using technology such as electronic key cloning and signal amplification to "bypass modern vehicle security systems", Deer said.

Vehicles could often be stolen quickly while leaving few forensic opportunities for investigators.

"The rising value of used vehicles and vehicle parts has also made this type of offending more profitable," he said.

He also said vehicle theft investigations had become more complex because offenders often operated across force boundaries.

"Devon and Cornwall Police remains committed to pursuing all available lines of inquiry and bringing offenders to justice wherever the evidence supports it," he said.

Devon and Cornwall Police has its own advice on how to deter vehicle thieves.

Sgt Owen Messenger, from the force's road casualty reduction team, said vehicle owners can take simple steps to make themselves less of a target.

He said one of the easiest ways to protect keyless vehicles was to keep keys in a Faraday pouch or box, which blocks the electronic signal that thieves can use to gain access to a car.

He also suggested keeping keys away from front doors, where criminals may be able to amplify the signal from outside a property.

He also recommended aftermarket immobilisers and alarm systems to make a vehicle as difficult and time-consuming to steal as possible.

"Essentially you're trying to make it more and more difficult for the thief to take your car," he said.

"The longer it takes them to do it, the less likely they are to try and do it, because there's more chance of them getting caught."

Messenger said he personally fitted aftermarket security systems to cars he believed were at greater risk of theft because he considered the extra expense worthwhile to protect his investment.

articles.title: Colombia inaugurates embassy to Israel in Jerusalem
articles.summary: Palestinian officials slam move by Colombian government that marked major shift after ex-president had cut Israel ties.
articles.body:
Colombia has opened its embassy to Israel in Jerusalem , joining a small group of countries in taking the controversial step of backing Israel’s claim to sovereignty in the contested city.

Palestinian officials swiftly denounced the inauguration on Wednesday that came as Israel is facing mounting international pressure over the genocidal war on Gaza, where three years of attacks have killed more than 74,000 people.

The move by the administration of new Colombian President Abelardo de la Espriella is a major shift from his left-wing predecessor Gustavo Petro, who in 2024 severed ties with Israel over the war on Gaza.

De la Espriella, who was sworn in in August , has also restored a free trade agreement between Israel and Colombia that Petro terminated.

Colombian Minister of Foreign Affairs Omar ‌Bula Escobar said on Wednesday that relations between the two countries “should ⁠never have been broken” and that Bogota was taking “taking a concrete step towards ⁠restoring diplomatic relations”.

“Israel is a strategic partner. It always has been, and from now on, it will be an even stronger one,” he said during a ceremony that marked the embassy’s opening.

The opening made Colombia the 10th country to establish its embassy in Israel in Jerusalem – most countries keep their formal diplomatic missions in Tel Aviv.

Israeli Foreign Minister Gideon Saar welcomed the move during the ceremony. “This is an important date for the State of Israel. It’s also an important date for the city of Jerusalem,” he said while signing the Colombian embassy’s guest book.

Colombian Ambassador Tania Gilinski said Israel had always been a “strategic partner” and that moving forward it “will be so with even greater determination and strength”.

The Palestinian Authority condemned Colombia’s embassy move, calling it “a violation of international legitimacy resolutions” that undermines “the international consensus on the legal status of the holy city”.

Jordan’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs also criticised the move as a “violation of international law and relevant international resolutions”.

United States President Donald Trump moved the US embassy to Israel from Tel Aviv to Jerusalem during his first term in 2018, angering Palestinians and sparking international condemnation. Previous US presidents, as well as nearly every other country, refrained from opening embassies in Jerusalem, arguing that the city’s final status should first be resolved in negotiations between Israelis and Palestinians.

The status of Jerusalem remains one of the core unresolved issues of the Israeli-Palestinian conflict, with Israel claiming the undivided city as its capital while Palestinians view occupied East Jerusalem as the capital of a future Palestinian state.

Israel occupied East Jerusalem and annexed it in 1967, in a move not recognised by the vast majority of the international community.

Since Trump relocated the US embassy to Jerusalem, only a handful of small, US-aligned countries have followed suit, namely Fiji, Guatemala, Honduras, Papua New Guinea, Paraguay and Nauru. Kosovo and Somaliland, which are not member-states of the United Nations, have also opened what they consider their embassies in Jerusalem.

articles.title: 6 dead in Wisconsin plane crash
articles.summary: The FAA says 6 people were onboard the plane.
articles.body:
Six people are dead following a plane crash Tuesday night near Reedsburg, Wisconsin, Tuesday night, according to a statement from the Sauk County Sheriff's Office.

The sheriff's office said in an initial statement that the Sauk County Dispatch Center received reports of a downed plane just after 9:30 on Tuesday night.

Deputies and emergency personnel located the aircraft with "multiple individuals involved."

Five adults and one child were on board the plane, which was flying a return trip from Kenosha, Wisconsin, to Menomonie, Wisconsin, officials said in a follow-up statement.

"As a result of the search, all six occupants of the aircraft were located deceased on scene," according to the sheriff's office.

According to authorities, the plane was located "in a densely wooded area."

The sheriff's office said the plane was reportedly "in contact with a nearby air traffic control tower," and they are working to learn what the transmissions were "and if a weather event in the area may have played any role in the crash."

Authorities are not identifying the deceased at this time.

The sheriff's office also shared there have been no reports of damage to structures or injuries to people on the ground.

The Federal Aviation Administration said the plane was a Piper PA-46.

According to preliminary information included in a statement from the National Transportation Safety Board, "the plane was flying at 24,000 feet when the pilot reported icing and requested to descend."

According to the NTSB, "Air traffic control approved the descent, and the aircraft entered a right descending turn that increased in rate until communications and data tracking were lost."

The NTSB said investigators are traveling to the scene, and a preliminary report will be available within 30 days.

Investigators are working "to determine the circumstances surrounding the crash," according to the sheriff's office.

The FAA and NTSB are investigating the crash, with the NTSB leading the investigation, according to the FAA statement.

Reedsburg is a southern Wisconsin town located near the Wisconsin Dells and roughly 55 miles northwest of Madison, Wisconsin.

articles.title: UK prosecution labels Russell Brand a ruthless sexual predator at opening of his sex assault trial
articles.summary: Russell Brand behaved as a “ruthless” sexual predator when he assaulted six women over the course of a decade, a prosecutor said Wednesday, as she opened the rape and sexual assault case against the actor-comedian.
articles.body: Russell Brand behaved as a “ruthless” sexual predator when he assaulted six women over the course of a decade, a prosecutor said Wednesday, as she opened the rape and sexual assault case against the actor-comedian. Brand, 51, has pleaded not guilty to three counts of rape, three counts of sexual assault and one count of indecent assault. The charges involve six women and alleged offenses between 1999 and 2009. Prosecutor Riel Karmy-Jones told jurors at Southwark Crown Court in London that the six women, who don’t know each other, were assaulted by Brand in “a hotel room, workplaces, a toilet cubicle in a bar and at his home address.” She said that at the time that Brand had an “indiscriminate and voracious” desire for sexual contact, and “women were simply a means to an end.” The prosecutor said that Brand could be funny and charming, “a flirt with a huge sexual appetite — childlike in his expectation that his every desire should be met.” “He was ruthless, he was calculating, he was manipulative. And, the prosecution say, he was a sexual predator,” Karmy-Jones said. The jury will hear from Brand’s accusers later in the trial Brand listened intently from the dock as the prosecutor described each of the alleged incidents, including the earliest, in which Brand allegedly raped a woman in a hotel room during the Labour Party’s annual conference in 1999. Brand, then a rising stand-up comedian, was performing in a cabaret on the fringe of the conference in the English coastal town of Bournemouth. Two years later, another woman alleges, Brand tried to drag her into the men’s bathroom at the office building where she worked. “There can be little doubt as to what Mr. Brand’s intention was,” Karmy-Jones said. A third woman alleges that Brand orally raped her in 2004 in the restroom of a London bar, telling her “Don’t be a spoilsport” when she asked him to stop. The prosecutor said that the other charges relate to a woman who says Brand kissed and groped her at a London radio station in 2004 or 2005, leaving her feeling “dirty and disgusting”; a then-21-year-old fan who says Brand anally raped her at his home after she met him at one of his shows in 2009; and a woman who says Brand demanded a massage and pressed his face into her groin during the recording of an advertisement in 2009. Karmy-Jones told the jury that none of the alleged victims reported the alleged assaults at the time, due to guilt, shame and concern that they would be blamed. She said that jurors would hear from the women later in the trial, and “I have no doubt you will find their evidence compelling.” Brand denies all the charges. In police interviews, he denied ever engaging in nonconsensual sexual activity. Brand has shifted away from mainstream media to an online audience Brand is on bail and arrived at court on Wednesday to a crowd of photographers and video journalists. He said he felt “blessed.” “I feel, of course, concerned but hopeful that this process will lead to good outcomes for everybody involved,” Brand said. “That’s my prayer.” Known for risque stand-up routines and battles with drugs and alcohol, Brand rose to prominence in the early 2000s, hosting television programs and his own BBC radio show. He appeared in Hollywood films including “Forgetting Sarah Marshall” and “Get Him to the Greek.” In recent years he has moved away from mainstream media, relocated to Florida and built a large online following with videos mixing wellness, conspiracy theories and discussions of his religious devotion. The Associated Press doesn’t name victims of alleged sexual violence, and British law protects their identities from the media for life.

articles.title: Burnham treads carefully in Zelensky visit, balancing Trump and Ukraine
articles.summary: The UK's prime minister meets with Volodymyr Zelensky after a rocky week for the Ukraine president.
articles.body:
President Volodymyr Zelensky's visit to London follows a well-trodden diplomatic path in a war now in its fifth year.

For months, US President Donald Trump had been a largely benign presence in the conflict, promising Ukraine greater access to American air defence technology and threatening more sanctions on Russia.

Then last week Trump carried out an abrupt U-turn, lifting sanctions on Russian diesel and calling for Zelensky to be replaced.

Once again Ukraine's leader got on his plane to shore up support among European allies. Today London, tomorrow Brussels.

For the prime minister there was the tricky but now familiar diplomatic task of needing to show solidarity with Zelensky without appearing to criticise Trump.

Burnham's answer was to say and announce as much as he could without exposing himself to questions from journalists asking about Trump's latest betrayal of Kyiv.

So Downing Street issued an embargoed press notice overnight with warm words of support for Zelensky.

It said Burnham would promise to go "further and faster" in helping Ukraine with financial and military aid.

Specifically, the prime minister would pledge to speed up the delivery of lightweight multirole missiles that can help bring down fast jet-powered Russian drones.

There was a military honour guard in Downing Street to greet Ukraine's president, followed by a controlled photo opportunity showing the start of the meeting between the two men.

In No10, before that meeting, Burnham told Zelensky that Britain stood with him "at this difficult time".

He said it was clear "who the aggressor is" after Russia's attacks on Ukraine's critical national infrastructure. And crucially he praised Zelensky for his "leadership" in being prepared to sit down and discuss Donald Trump's call for an energy ceasefire.

In his reply, Zelensky said it was an "absolutely terrible time" for Ukraine. There was no energy ceasefire, he said, but Russian escalation instead.

He said Ukraine "counted on partnership with the US" but spoke of "some difficulties" and "different surprises" with Ukraine's access to US intelligence and the Starlink satellite network.

In the House of Commons, at the start of his weekly question time, Burnham used the opportunity to offer what he called his "unwavering" support for Zelensky and promise greater military and financial aid in the future.

But it fell to the Liberal Democrat leader, Sir Ed Davey, to ask the question journalists might have asked if they had the chance.

Sir Ed said the prime minister had studiously avoided commenting on Trump's decision to rip up international sanctions on Russia.

"This House does deserve to know his position, as does frankly President Zelensky and our brave Ukrainian allies," Sir Ed said.

"Doesn't he agree this is yet another shameful Trump betrayal of the Ukrainian people and European security?"

In reply, Burnham admitted it was a "very dark and difficult moment" for Zelensky, who was "carrying the heaviest of weights" right now.

But Burnham eschewed the chance to criticise Trump and told MPs this: "What I have to do in my role is try and repair bridges so that the support comes back and therefore I should, at this moment in time, be careful in terms of laying the ground to bring people back together."

"That is the role I intend to play - it's the right role for me to play - in this moment. I will listen to President Zelensky carefully but he won't be going away from Britain today empty handed."

In other words, do not expect the prime minister to join in the widespread European criticism of Trump.

After the now infamous falling out between Trump and Zelensky in the Oval Office in February 2025 , the UK played a key role in calming the row and bringing both sides back together.

A key player was national security adviser Jonathan Powell, who shuttled between Washington and Kyiv pouring oil on troubled waters. It seems Burnham hopes the UK can play a similar bridge-building role now.

For millions of Ukrainians facing a grim winter potentially with less US support than before, the task could not be more urgent.

articles.title: A Louisiana landowner bought 300 acres to raise cattle, but repeated floods changed his plans; he is now restoring wetlands and planting 183 acres of forest to connect wildlife habitats
articles.summary: A Louisiana landowner planned to raise cattle and grow soybeans on his property. However, repeated flooding from the Boeuf River made farming difficult.
articles.body: A Louisiana landowner planned to raise cattle and grow soybeans on his property. However, repeated flooding from the Boeuf River made farming difficult. Michael Liles, who runs the land-development business 5L Land Development, turned to wetland restoration with help from the US Department of Agriculture’s Natural Resources Conservation Service (NRCS). The project covers more than 300 acres in Franklin Parish. It includes restoring water movement across 9.2 acres and establishing 183 acres of bottomland hardwood forest in February 2026. The restored land connects existing wildlife corridors and is intended to benefit species such as the Louisiana black bear and the endangered northern long-eared bat.How repeated floods changed a Louisiana landowner's plans for 300 acresLiles initially intended to use the flood-prone land for cattle grazing and soybean farming. However, repeated flooding made it difficult to turn those plans into a viable operation. Having experience with land development and conservation programmes, he explored an alternative that would allow the property to support wetland habitat and wildlife.In January 2023, Liles applied to enrol the property in the Agricultural Conservation Easement Program’s Wetland Reserve Easement component, known as ACEP-WRE. The land lies in Franklin Parish, near the Boeuf River, Boeuf Wildlife Management Area and other properties already enrolled in wetland conservation programmes.The property was selected for programme funding in 2024. NRCS subsequently worked with Liles to complete the easement acquisition and develop a restoration plan. The agency closed the acquisition in April 2025, 303 days after the agreement to purchase, compared with an average of roughly 564 days over the preceding decade.How 183 acres of forest were establishedLiles, who owns the land-construction business 5L Land Development, requested to carry out the restoration work himself through a landowner contract. NRCS collaborated with him on the planning and design, discussing restoration options and approving the work to be undertaken.The planning and design phase was completed in May 2025. Tree-site preparation followed in August, with hydrology restoration carried out across 9.2 acres. The project reached another milestone in February 2026, when 183 acres of bottomland hardwood forest were established.Bottomland hardwood forests are adapted to low-lying areas that experience periodic flooding. Restoring this type of forest can help recreate habitat suited to river landscapes, while wetland restoration can recover natural water movement and other wetland functions.The project's different components serve distinct purposes. The hydrology work focuses on water movement, while the forest establishment provides wooded habitat across a much larger area. Together, they form part of a broader effort to restore the ecological value of land that proved difficult to use for conventional farming.How the restoration could benefit wildlifeAccording to NRCS, the restored property connects and extends existing wildlife corridors, creating additional habitat connectivity for wildlife in the region. The agency identifies the Louisiana black bear and northern long-eared bat among the species that can benefit from these connections.The northern long-eared bat is federally listed as endangered in the US, following severe population declines associated largely with white-nose syndrome, a disease that affects bats. The Louisiana black bear, meanwhile, was removed from the federal Endangered Species Act list in 2016 after its recovery, although it remains protected under Louisiana state law.Wetland Reserve Easements are designed to protect, restore and enhance wetlands that have previously been degraded, including through agricultural use. NRCS says such projects can provide habitat for fish and wildlife, improve water quality by filtering sediments and chemicals, help reduce flooding, recharge groundwater and support biodiversity.The restoration of Liles's property also builds on conservation work in the surrounding landscape. Its proximity to the Boeuf Wildlife Management Area and other conservation-enrolled land gives the project a role in extending habitat connections beyond the property itself.For Liles, the project was also an opportunity to create something lasting for his family. NRCS said he wanted to share his connection to the land with his wife, Kristi, and their five children: LillyMae, Trace, Levi, Gus and Charlotte.Rather than continuing to try to turn flood-prone land into something it was poorly suited for, he worked with conservation officials to restore its wetland and forest functions.You use AI every day. articles.title: German police launch investigation after robot allegedly gropes teenage girl
articles.summary: Police in Germany have launched an investigation into possible sexual assault after a robot controlled by two teenage boys allegedly grinded against a 16-year-old girl and touched her buttocks.
articles.body: Police in Germany have launched an investigation into possible sexual assault after a robot controlled by two teenage boys allegedly grinded against a 16-year-old girl and touched her buttocks. The incident occurred in the city of Cologne in the western state of North Rhine-Westphalia late on Sunday night. The 16-year-old owner of the robot and his 19-year-old companion filmed the alleged attack and live-streamed it on social media, according to police. The girl was outside a fast-food restaurant between 11.45 p.m. and midnight local time with female friends aged 17 and 18. The robot, which was around 1.20 meters (120 cm) high, approached the girl from behind and carried out the actions, police said. Emergency services were dispatched to the scene, where they found the alleged assailants and discovered the robot in the trunk of a vehicle, according to police. Authorities seized the robot and mobile phones belonging to the two suspects. Video footage circulating online shows a robot dressed in a white vest with a gold chain and sunglasses approaching women on the streets and making sexually-explicit gestures. Authorities are looking into whether the robot’s movements were pre-programmed or deliberately being controlled at the time of the incident.

articles.title: Pennsylvania woman stabbed young son and husband to death at Great Wolf Lodge water park, police say
articles.summary: Metallica Rose Harrison killed her 3-year-old son and husband before failing to kill herself at  popular Pennsylvania water park Great Wolf Lodge, authorities said.
articles.body: A woman killed her husband and 3-year-old son at a popular Pennsylvania water park before asking police for their help to die by suicide because she couldn’t “find the vein in her neck to stab,” authorities said Tuesday. Officers rushed to the Great Wolf Lodge at 3:13 p.m. on Monday after a “distressed female” in Room 2030 “advised the dispatcher that she needed help committing suicide,” according to a Poconos Township Police Department statement. That caller, 27-year-old Towanda resident Metallica Rose Harrison, told a dispatcher she wanted to die by suicide but needed help “to find the vein in her neck to stab,” according to a criminal complaint written by Detective Earl Ackerman. Charles Harrison “suffered multiple stab wounds to the chest” while a 3-year-old child, identified only as “T.H.,” was found dead with a “single stab wound to the chest,” according to Ackerman. She was taken to the hospital, accompanied by police, allegedly telling them in the ambulance that “everyday, I work so hard” to “be the best person, the best mother, the best wife,” the complaint said. “‘It wasn’t supposed to end like this. I was supposed to have my happy family. That’s what I envisioned since I was a child, ’” according to Ackerman’s statement, quoting the suspect. Harrison also asked how deep she needed to slice her wrist for the “next time,” the complaint said. Investigators found a “large butcher kitchen knife” in Room 2030’s bathroom floor and a “smaller knife” in the bathroom sink, the complaint said. The family originally checked into Great Wolf on Sept. 21 and they were scheduled to leave on Tuesday. The suspect allegedly told a dispatcher that police could find the bodies in their room with the complaint quoting her saying that “my husband and son are already gone in the bed in the living room.” “They’re already gone, I’m sorry,” she said, according to the affidavit. Harrison was booked on suspicion of two counts of homicide. “This case is an isolated domestic tragedy and there is no threat to the community,” according to the police statement. “Our thoughts and deepest condolences go out to the family and loved ones affected by this tragedy.” The famed water park and child-friendly vacation destination is a little more than 100 miles north of central Philadelphia. “We are deeply saddened and heartbroken by a tragic domestic incident that occurred yesterday in a guest room at our resort in the Pocono Mountains,” according to a Great Wold Lodge statement. “It was an isolated family incident, and we’re cooperating fully with local law enforcement as they conduct their investigation. Our thoughts are with the family and loved ones of those affected.” A judge ordered Harrison held without bail on Tuesday and it wasn’t immediately clear on Wednesday if she’d hired or been appointed an attorney to speak on her behalf. Messages left at publicly listed phone numbers for the suspect and victim were not immediately returned on Wednesday. If you or someone you know is in crisis, call 988 to reach the Suicide and Crisis Lifeline. You can also call the network, previously known as the National Suicide Prevention Lifeline, at 800-273-8255, text HOME to 741741 or visit SpeakingOfSuicide.com/resources for additional resources.

articles.title: Ankita Bhandari case: 'VIP' question brings her parents to India Gate; Uttarakhand government reacts
articles.summary: NEW DELHI: Nearly four years after the murder of 19-year-old Ankita Bhandari in Uttarakhand, questions over an alleged VIP’s role in the case have
articles.body: NEW DELHI: Nearly four years after the murder of 19-year-old Ankita Bhandari in Uttarakhand, questions over an alleged VIP’s role in the case have resurfaced following a controversial political appointment.The appointment of former BJP national general secretary Dushyant Kumar Gautam as Sikkim governor on Monday has prompted fresh outrage from Ankita’s family, who have named him as the alleged VIP in the case. Her parents are now protesting at India Gate in Delhi, demanding that President Droupadi Murmu halt his appointment until the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) completes its probe into the alleged VIP angle.“Dushyant Kumar should be behind bars... I earnestly request the Honorable President not to appoint Dushyant Kumar as governor until the CBI investigation is concluded,” Ankita’s father, Virendra Singh Bhandari, said in Delhi.Her mother, Soni Devi, said the family was deeply hurt by the appointment and appealed to the President to intervene.“We were deeply pained when we heard the news on the 12th that he (BJP leader Dushyant Kumar Gautam) has now been named Governor. I appeal to the Honourable President, who is herself a woman and will surely understand my sentiments, to halt the move to appoint this individual as Governor until the CBI investigation against him is concluded,” she said.The appointment has triggered fresh political backlash, with the Congress accusing the Modi government of protecting Gautam instead of ensuring justice for Ankita’s family. The allegations against Gautam have not been established in court.What did state government say?The Uttarakhand government on Wednesday said its legal efforts had ensured that the accused in the Ankita Bhandari murder case remained behind bars, after a court once again rejected their bail applications. It cited the life sentences awarded to the convicts, the constitution of a Special Investigation Team (SIT) and the CBI probe ordered at the request of Ankita’s parents as steps taken to secure justice.The government said the accused were arrested within 24 hours of the incident coming to light, while a chargesheet of around 500 pages was prepared, incorporating evidence and statements from nearly 100 witnesses. It also said the prosecution had consistently opposed bail, ensuring the accused remained in custody during the trial. The case ultimately resulted in life imprisonment for the convicts.The state said it had changed the government counsel three times in response to the family’s demands and ordered a CBI investigation after Ankita’s parents sought one. It added that the family received financial assistance of Rs 25 lakh, while jobs were provided to Ankita’s father and brother.The government also criticised Congress leaders and other organisations for repeatedly raising questions over the alleged VIP angle. It said anyone with concrete evidence should present it to the investigating agencies or the court, rather than making public allegations. The government accused political leaders of attempting to politicise the case and mislead the public.Congress questions appointmentCongress MP Pawan Khera questioned why Gautam had been appointed governor before the CBI investigation was completed. He alleged that the decision amounted to granting protection to a person facing allegations.“You granted them immunity. You aren't even waiting for the CBI inquiry. What is the pressure to wrap this up so quickly? Who are you shielding? Is there anyone else you need to protect? Who is being blackmailed here—forcing you to appoint someone as a high-ranking official just to grant them immunity? Why risk everything?” Khera said.He accused the government of siding with the person facing allegations rather than the victim’s family.“The very people who are supposed to deliver justice are not standing with the victim. They have sided with the accused—the person facing the allegations...” he said.In a separate statement, the Congress alleged that Ankita was pressured to provide sexual favours to Gautam and was murdered after refusing. The party accused Prime Minister Narendra Modi of rewarding Gautam by appointing him governor."Narendra Modi has rewarded the very Dushyant Gautam against whom allegations were made by appointing him as the Governor of Sikkim. The daughters and women of the country are watching how Narendra Modi and his government are protecting Dushyant Gautam. Instead of delivering justice to Ankita Bhandari, the entire BJP government is bent on silencing the voice of the victim's family," it said.Rahul Gandhi and Priyanka Gandhi Vadra also met Ankita’s family at India Gate. Rahul had earlier raised questions over the handling of the case, saying the family was still waiting for justice nearly four years after her death.Why is the VIP angle still under investigation?An FIR was registered against an unidentified VIP in January 2026, following allegations and the circulation of audio and video clips referring to the alleged involvement of a VIP in Ankita’s murder.Uttarakhand chief minister Pushkar Singh Dhami recommended a CBI probe on January 9. The agency subsequently took up the case through its Special Crime Branch and obtained records, including the police FIR and the Special Investigation Team’s report.The investigation has drawn criticism from the Congress. Uttarakhand Pradesh Congress Committee president Ganesh Godiyal alleged that the CBI had made no meaningful progress and had not registered an FIR against the person named by Ankita’s parents. He also announced a one-hour silent fast in Dehradun to protest Gautam’s appointment.The family’s demand is that the alleged VIP angle be investigated and that the appointment be halted until the probe is complete. The allegations against Gautam remain unproven.What happened to Ankita Bhandari?Ankita, 19, worked as a receptionist at Vanantra Resort near Rishikesh. She was murdered in September 2022, and her body was recovered from the Cheela canal on September 24.The case involved allegations that she was pressured to provide sexual favours to guests at the resort, which was run by Pulkit Arya, the son of a former BJP leader.Resort owner Pulkit Arya, manager Saurabh Bhaskar and another accused, Ankita Gupta, have been sentenced to life imprisonment for the murder.However, the convictions did not end demands for an investigation into the alleged VIP angle. The registration of an FIR against an unidentified VIP in January 2026 brought renewed attention to the case.Gautam’s appointment as Sikkim governor has now prompted Ankita’s parents to take their demand to India Gate, urging the President to halt the appointment until the CBI investigation is concluded.Get the latest India News and Live updates. articles.title: Police confiscate robot that groped 16-year-old girl, probe whether young men were at the controls
articles.summary: German authorities opened an investigation into possible sexual harassment after a robot controlled by two young men touched the buttocks of a 16-year-old girl and made thrusting movements toward her, police said.
articles.body: German authorities opened an investigation into possible sexual harassment after a robot controlled by two young men touched the buttocks of a 16-year-old girl and made thrusting movements toward her, police said. Police in the western city of Cologne responded after the incident overnight Saturday to Sunday in which the robot's suspected 16-year-old owner and a 19-year-old companion were said to have filmed the alleged assault. They were said to have streamed the incident and commentated on it online. Cologne police spokesman Christoph Bermel said the two male teenagers have not been charged but are considered suspects, and investigators were examining whether the robot's movements were preprogrammed or controlled in real time. Police were unfamiliar with this type of incident, he said. “We have not been aware of this phenomenon so far," Bermel told The Associated Press, saying it was "new territory for us.” Emergency teams that were dispatched to the scene near a fast-food restaurant found the robot in the trunk of a vehicle, Cologne police said in a statement on Monday. The robot and the two young men's mobile phones were confiscated. North Rhine Westphalia Police Cologne, on Facebook, posted an image of the red-and-gold robot lying on the ground. The robot, said to be 120 cm (about 3 ft 11 inches) tall, was dressed in a white tank top, black sweatpants and wearing a gold chain and sunglasses. It also had what appears to be a fake mustache. Videos circulated on the internet show two young men escorting the robot toward a group of women, bumping into one and hugging others, on a lively nighttime street. One of the men repeatedly shouts at the robot and pulls it backward after it makes sexual gestures, prompting laughter among people in the area. On the police's Facebook account on Tuesday, officers criticized inappropriate comments and warned that sharing or joking about such incidents can worsen the impact on any victim.
